Portal.title: Web3 Samples
Portal.description: Small practice apps for seeing how blockchains work by touching something that runs. Everything runs on testnets; no real money is involved.

minisig.title: MiniSig
minisig.description: A multisig wallet built from scratch and running on Base Sepolia, with an API that collects proposals and signatures.

st-registry.title: Real-estate ST Description Registry
st-registry.description: Two properties at 100% occupancy: one can be pledged, the other is refused by the contract. The difference lies in the description vocabulary.

chain-lens.title: Chain Lens
chain-lens.description: Read real on-chain transactions to see what is public, what is encrypted, and what was never written. No wallet needed.

tictactoe.title: On-chain Tic-Tac-Toe
tictactoe.description: Tic-tac-toe that runs entirely in a smart contract. Both players stake the same amount and the winner takes the pot.
